property_summary: For any caller and any uint256 newDifficulty, calling AdjustDifficulty(newDifficulty) as the contract owner always succeeds (does not revert) and sets currentDifficulty() to newDifficulty; the mutant that replaces onlyOwner's require with require(false) makes AdjustDifficulty revert for the owner, violating this property for some inputs.
change_summary: Remove the require checking owner in onlyOwner modifier by changing it to require false, preventing owner-only functions (including AdjustDifficulty) from succeeding and thus changing observable behavior.
